capabilities: Group notes into folder-based community clusters
Route links to avoid line crossings
Search and highlight nodes in real time
Open notes from node clicks and context menus
disambiguation: Not a re-skin of the built-in graph view; it adds its own cluster-organized view with hulls and bridge-link routing.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A folder-based cluster graph view plugin for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows notes as one unstructured web, so topic communities and cross-cluster bridges are hard to see.
summary: Folder-based cluster graph view that groups notes into communities with convex hulls, bridge links, crossing avoidance, and live node search.
